harness_checkout.scope: harness checkout at match start; not proof of either binary's build source

source_provenance_note: Current checkout and frozen bytes are recorded; no claim that HEAD alone identifies the engine build.

opening_family_bootstrap95.scope: Descriptive fixed opening-family bootstrap; three seeds and both colors remain together. No Elo or universal strength interval.

summary.score_scope: Completed games only; incomplete games remain unfinished, never draws.
summary.resource_scope: Different played positions; aggregate nodes/depth are not same-position speed comparisons.
summary.time_scope: 100ms requested, 80ms after 20ms internal Move Overhead; wall overruns are reported rather than clock forfeits.

external_engine_guard.scope: Zero observed external named engine CPU ticks; sampled process discovery. Unknown/transient engines between samples and non-engine host load are not excluded.
